chunks: "It is mentioned that he would kiss the mihjan (staff)."

key_terms.الْمِحْجَنَ: the mihjan, a hooked staff or walking stick

ai.seo_question: What does the narration say about kissing the mihjan during tawaf?
ai.summary: This report mentions a practice related to tawaf, stating that he would kiss the mihjan. It reflects a transmitted Prophetic tradition connected to the rites and etiquette of hajj worship.
